articles.summary: HOUSTON and LONDON – Feb. 24, 2026 – Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR), an energy technology company, announced Tuesday an award to supply 25 BRUSH™ Power Generation electric generators, along with Automatic Voltage Regulators (AVRs) and cubicles to Boom Supersonic. These specialized generators will be paired with Boom’s innovative 42 megawatt (MW) Superpower natural gas turbines to deliver highly efficient and reliable electricity for advanced AI data centers.
articles.title: Baker Hughes Secures 1.21 Gigawatt Generator Order to Power Boom Supersonic’s AI Data Center Solution
